mapper.select: SELECT id, summary_type, target_type, target_id, summary, positives, negatives, review_count, model_name, summary_available, generated_at, expires_at, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_summaries WHERE summary_type = #{summaryType} AND target_id = #{targetId} AND (target_type = #{targetType} OR target_type IS NULL) AND expires_at > NOW() AND summary_available = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_summaries SET expires_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE target_id = #{targetId} AND summary_type = 'REVIEW'
